recipes.label: The Wisdom of Scars
recipes.startdescription: I have learned much since this campaign began. My lessons cover my skin, written in scar tissue. This one has been scarred, too. . . Perhaps I could guide them down the same road I have taken. But these ancient techniques are NOT the same as medical attention. Those unsuited to the mysteries will simply die, and survivors will be fragile at best.
recipes.description: My hand does not tremble as I cut away wounded limbs. My voice does not waver as I speak the secrets I have learned. The sightless gaze of the tribune does not falter as he watches from above.

recipes.label: To Reforge what is not Broken
recipes.startdescription: It is in the lionsmith's nature to become stronger, forever stronger. I know a training exercise that could allow these men to imitate that nature. Many will die of exhaustion, but those that remain will become strong enough to shatter stone and dent metal.

recipes.label: The Truth
recipes.startdescription: My ally is bound. The knife rests in my hand. Class is in session.

recipes.label: <color=red>HURTS<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: They jolt as I grab the sides of their head, hard enough to hurt. I can smell the fear in them as I lean closer. I whisper in their ear one, little word. . .

recipes.label: The Experience of Scars
recipes.description: The wounds have been consecrated. The prosthetics click into place. The room smells of gunpowder and snow. This one will be an asset to me.

recipes.label: The Suffering of Scars
recipes.description: They flinched. They begged me to stop. I did not yield. Now they are dead.

recipes.label: The Strength of the Interior
recipes.description: These men are more determined than I expected. Our losses are minimal; our power grows.

recipes.label: The Courage of the Interior
recipes.description: Only a single one remains. I suppose I'll have to learn their name, now.

recipes.label: C'est la Guerre
recipes.description: One by one, they fall- exhaustion, heatstroke, put down by my hands as they try to desert on the spot. What a waste.

recipes.label: To Abandon Hope
recipes.description: The blood dries. Something hardens behind my ally's eyes. They know the wolf's truth, now.

recipes.label: Failure
recipes.description: They couldn't withstand the torture I inflicted. They feel nothing, now. Perhaps that's for the best.

recipes.label: <color=red>And Embrace Oblivion<color=#005500>
recipes.description: <color=red>I grip them tightly until the thrashing stops. When they rise, I can see a new cruelty in their eyes. They understand a level of hate they couldn't comprehend, before. Good.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: <color=red>Mortis<color=#005500>
recipes.description: <color=red>They couldn't withstand the torture I inflicted. They feel nothing, now. Perhaps that's for the best.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: The Experience of Scars
recipes.startdescription: The lessons learnt in the spilling of blood can be passed down to some of my men. Said men must be on the verge of death, however.

recipes.label: To Inspire Strength
recipes.startdescription: Some lessons learn in the shattering of bone could be passed down to my men. Said men must be strong themselves, however.

recipes.label: Reviled Knowledge
recipes.startdescription: No. I won't subject anyone else to the 'training' I went through.

recipes.label: To Abandon Hope?
recipes.startdescription:
I could teach this one some of the secrets that I've learned. But the lessons of the Wolf can only be learned through agony. . . More often than not, they'll simply die. But if this works, they'll become much more useful.

[The ally needs to have the 'Vicous' Aspect.]

recipes.label: <color=red>And Embrace Oblivion<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
<color=red>I could let this one in on a little secret. Tell them what I really think of them. It'll make them hurt, just like they deserve.<color=#005500>

[The ally needs to have the 'Vicous' Aspect.]
